notes: Compact PTZ camera (desktop/tabletop or wall-mount, not rack-mountable). Sourced from BirdDog's official X1/X1 Ultra User Manual (rear-panel diagram + Technical Specifications table) and the official Tech Specs page. Rear panel (per manual diagram) has exactly 5 wired physical ports plus a Wi-Fi antenna: DC 12V (barrel), RS232 (implemented over an RJ45 jack, VISCA control, pinout: pin3=GND, pin7=TX, pin8=RX per T-568B), USB 3.0 (USB-C connector, UVC 1.1), HDMI, and PoE/LAN (RJ45). The spec table also lists "RS485" and "10M/100M Ethernet" under Control Interface, but the physical rear-panel diagram shows only one RJ45 RS232/control port and one RJ45 PoE/LAN port — no separate RS485 physical connector is depicted, so RS485 was not added as a distinct port (likely logically available but not separately wired, or a documentation carryover from a shared control-board design). Ethernet is capped at 100M (Fast Ethernet, not Gigabit) per "100M adaptive Ethernet port" spec — graded eth-100m accordingly. HDMI grade omitted: manual/spec sheet state HDMI output and max video format 2160p@30fps but do not state an explicit HDMI version (1.4/2.0/2.1), so no grade was assigned per instructions (4K30 is achievable over HDMI 1.4 but this is an inference, not a stated spec). USB 3.0 port is physically USB-C; graded usb-5g (USB 3.0/3.1 Gen1 baseline = 5Gbps) since manual explicitly labels it "USB 3.0". Power: DC 12V barrel input (2.0A max, 13W max) plus PoE IEEE802.3af via the same RJ45 LAN port (not counted as a second power port, since it shares the LAN connector). No dedicated audio in/out ports exist on this camera. Manufacturer power adapter is external DC 12V (BD-P12-1), consistent with dc-barrel selection.
